body.en: Reach out on WhatsApp or by phone to arrange a time that works for you.
body.zh: 通过 WhatsApp 或电话联系诊所，约一个方便的时间。

body.en: We listen to what you’ve been experiencing, how long it has lasted, and how it affects daily life.
body.zh: 聆听你最近的经历、持续了多久，以及对日常生活的影响。

body.en: Dr. Hanni carries out a psychiatric assessment to understand what may be going on.
body.zh: 涵倪医生进行精神科评估，了解可能的原因。

body.en: We discuss the options and agree on next steps together, at a pace that feels right for you.
body.zh: 一起讨论可行的方案，按你适合的节奏商定下一步。
